bin.headline: This Monday, 3 August — recycling and garden waste.

events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: Bring your friends, grab a bingo book and get dabbing. Ticket sales from 7.15pm, eyes down at 8pm; cash only and over-18s only.

events.title: Inter-Generation Tennis Funday — Lenches Tennis Club
events.body: A fun, all-ages tennis day in memory of Rod Stroud, open to everyone — no club membership needed. Any two people with an age gap can pair up; barbecue, cakes, drinks and prizes, with the emphasis firmly on fun. To take part, email lenchestc@gmail.com.

events.title: Pershore Broad Street Market — Pershore
events.body: Around 30 stalls of farm-fresh produce, food and crafts — everything grown or made within 10 miles of the town — fill Broad Street from 9am to 2pm.

events.title: Peopleton Autumn Show — Peopleton
events.body: A traditional family village show from noon, with over 200 classic cars, morris dancers, live music, tug-of-war and dog classes.

events.title: Sherlock Holmes and the Mystery of the Governor's Nose — Lenches Amphitheatre
events.body: Jenny Wren Productions bring the season's final outdoor performance to the amphitheatre — a newly written Sherlock Holmes mystery. Gates 1pm, performance 2.30–4.30pm; the amphitheatre then closes for 2026.

events.title: Chandos Symphony Orchestra — Pershore Abbey
events.body: The Chandos Symphony Orchestra, conducted by Jack Lovell-Huckle, perform Holst, Tchaikovsky's Fifth Symphony and a Joanna Lee premiere in the Abbey, 3–5pm.

events.title: Broadway Autumn Show — Broadway
events.body: An inclusive family horticultural and craft show across the weekend on the Broadway village greens, with arts and craft stalls on the day.

events.title: Hampton Ferry Car and Bike Show — Evesham
events.body: A display of veteran, vintage, classic, kit and military vehicles and motorbikes at Hampton Ferry, 11am–4pm; spectators welcome.

events.title: Boules Finals Day — The Lenches Club
events.body: The 2026 boules season reaches its climax with the WI Spoon, Plate and Trophy finals from noon, followed by presentations and a shared lunch — bring a plate to share. Runs to around 4pm.

events.title: Pebworth Party in the Park — Pebworth
events.body: One of the region's premier village shows — a fun-packed afternoon on the village green blending traditional and modern attractions, from noon.

events.title: Cash Bingo — The Lenches Club
events.body: September's second bingo night. Ticket sales from 7.15pm, eyes down at 8pm; cash only and over-18s only, with cash prizes to be won.

events.title: Glo Quiz — The Lenches Club
events.body: Gather a team, bring your favourite tipple and compete for prizes at a live, hosted quiz night from 8pm.

events.title: A Celebration of Noel Coward — Bretforton
events.body: Evesham's own Alistair McGowan and his wife Charlotte perform a personal selection of Noel Coward's songs and rarely-heard poems at Bretforton Theatrebarn, from 7pm.

events.title: Jay & Eli live music — The Lenches Club
events.body: The Jay & Eli duo bring an evening of live acoustic rock and pop to the Club from 8.30pm.

eventsFootnote: Weekly regulars: yoga at Abbots Morton Village Hall on Mondays (9.45am), Lenches Tennis Club cardio on Tuesdays (6.30pm), tai chi at Abbots Morton on Wednesdays (10am), and candlelight yoga at Rous Lench Village Hall on Thursdays (6.30pm). Sunday services continue across the ARCH benefice churches at Harvington, Rous Lench, Abbots Morton, Church Lench and Norton & Lenchwick. Further afield, Flora Fields' pick-your-own dahlias run at Webbs, Wychbold until late September.

news.title: School applications open for September 2027
news.body: Applications for primary and secondary school places starting in September 2027 opened on 1 September 2026 — worth noting the date if you have a child due to start or move up.

news.title: Local MP returns to the backbenches
news.body: Mid Worcestershire MP Nigel Huddleston, whose constituency covers the Lenches, has said he will be returning to the backbenches following the latest reshuffle.

news.title: Cricket club: new players welcome
news.body: With the season just ended, the club is already looking ahead — players of all ages and abilities are wanted, whether experienced, returning or brand new. Contact Venky on 07442 772470 or Charlie on 07775 660065.

notices.title: Autumn tennis lessons for all ages
notices.body: The Tennis Club, with new partner Encompass Coaching, is running tennis lessons for children and adults this autumn — a good chance to brush up your game or start a new one.

notices.title: Newsletter deadline
notices.body: Got something for next week? Send it to website@thelenches.org.uk by the end of Wednesday.
